resources.reference_factor_budget: dynamic whole-workflow cap; not bounded p1 cap

resource_authority.swap_scope: same process tree sampled VmSwap; no global swap attribution

watchdog.memory_scope: dedicated subreaper parent plus all descendants; sampled simultaneous RSS
watchdog.swap_scope: same process tree sampled VmSwap; no global swap attribution

resources.method: max of simultaneous process-tree RSS sums within marker intervals; sampled, not allocation-exact
resources.cpu_limit: short-lived processes and final CPU before exit may be missed
resources.object_attribution: stage peak is a live-set peak, not size of an individual solver object
